caption: The video showcases a top-down view of a white tabletop where several small pre-formed clusters of shiny metallic magnetic spheres rest stationary at the left and top edges. At the center, a person's two hands, emerging from gray sweatshirt cuffs, hold a large tangled mass of the same spheres. The right hand lowers a separate small group of spheres from the upper-right toward the top edge of the mass and presses it into contact, adding a protrusion along the mass's upper boundary. The left hand, which cradles the mass's left side, then shifts its grip upward to secure this new top section. The right hand releases and briefly withdraws toward the right edge before re-entering to grasp the mass's right side. With both hands now holding the structure, the mass is rotated and slightly reshaped, its orientation shifting modestly in place. The stationary table clusters remain fixed, and the top-middle cluster becomes progressively occluded by the moving left hand, while the left forearm gradually covers part of the left-side cluster.
relations: Right hand presses a small sphere group onto the mass's top edge, creating a new protrusion.
Left hand shifts its grip upward to secure the newly added top section of the mass.
Right hand re-enters to grasp the mass's right side, enabling both hands to rotate and reshape it.
Stationary table clusters remain fixed while the moving left hand and forearm progressively occlude nearby groups.
